[P2] Return the untested error guards to the design phase

Rule 4, “Every branch has a test that fails without it,” remains unsatisfied. Both test parametrizations use the helper that raises `HELPER_FAILURE`; neither exercises a different error message or an unexpected successful return. Removing either defensive rejection leaves the assertions unchanged, so these added failure paths have no regression protection. Return to the design phase under rule 8 and decide whether these cases belong in the scenario with meaningful coverage, or whether the fixed fixture permits a simpler approach.
